nom: Sweet July Skin Pava Exfoliating Cleanser

segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are overwhelmingly positive, several saying it's one of the few cleansers that doesn't turn their skin red or irritated, including one who says almost everything else makes her red; no reviewer with explicitly sensitive skin reports irritation from this cleanser.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry or dry-sensitive skin consistently report it doesn't dry out or strip their skin the way other cleansers have, some saying they barely need a moisturizer afterward even though it's an exfoliant.
segments.normal: One reviewer with normal-to-dry skin finds it soothing and never over-cleansing, calling it perfect for her skin type.
segments.combination: One reviewer with sensitive, dry/combination skin found it very hydrating and well suited to her skin.

concerns.dehydration: Hydration is the most repeated effect: reviewers across skin types, including several with dry or sensitive skin, say the cleanser doesn't dry out or strip their skin despite being an exfoliant, often leaving it soft, plump, and sometimes needing no follow-up moisturizer.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with sensitive skin, who says almost every other product makes her red, reports this cleanser caused no redness at all.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer says the AHA in this cleanser tends to make her break out, despite otherwise liking the clean, smooth feel it gives; other reviewers more generally credit the line with clearer, blemish-free skin.
concerns.spots: A couple of reviewers dealing with hyperpigmentation report visible fading of dark splotches or brighter skin within about two weeks of use.
concerns.aging: A couple of older reviewers, including one in her 60s, feel the cleanser and routine have made their skin look noticeably younger, though these are subjective impressions from a cleanser rather than a targeted anti-aging treatment.

aspects.libelle: Mint intensity too strong for some
Gentle exfoliating beads, safe for daily use
Hard to tell how much product is left

extraits.texte: Unfortunately this cleanser contains AHA which from my experience causes me to break out, I should have checked the ingredients fully before buying the set lol but overall, when I used it the first time my face did feel clean, smooth and exfoliated. It's just not good for my skin.

extraits.texte: I love All the products except the mint in this cleanser; it is so strong that the vapors from it sting my eyes and it's too cooling on my face which feels uncomfortable.

I've been using Sweet July cleanser for a while now and I love it. I have normal (to dry) skin and find it soothing and invigorating. Love the fact that they use natural ingredients that includes a great exfoliator, perfect for my skin type. Also, it never leaves my skin feeling "over cleansed". I highly recommend this product!!

I love the Pava Exfoliating Cleanser. It is light, smooth, and and gentle on my skin (I have very sensitive and dry skin). I've been using the cleanser for two weeks and already my skin is brighter and more smooth. I deal with hyperpigmentation so the added glycolic acid is a bonus for me. Also love the smell and how fresh my face feels after using.

extraits.texte: I love this product! I have very dry, sensitive skin and it's one of the only cleansers I can use that doesn't make my skin feel like it could crack because it's so dry after using it. I don't even need moisturizer after I use it most of the time!

Loving the Pava exfoliating wash. I have sensitive skin and almost everything makes me red. This wash did not at all!!! I've been using it for a couple weeks now and already notice clearer and glowing skin! It will be my new go to!

Love the pava exfoliating cleanser! I immediately noticed the sweet guava/papaya/lychee scent, and I was left with a minty fresh, clean feeling :). It's also super hydrating and works great for my sensitive, dry/combination skin.
